statement: [pilot frontier risk assessments with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta and Amazon] These companies have also provided access and tokens, which we use for evaluations, research, and engineering.
However, frontier AI companies currently provide a significant amount of free tokens for our evaluations, research, and engineering.
OpenAI provided us with the dump of ~1.2 million entries from the main message board and the dataset of ~1300 transcripts we describe below, as well as free API credits for GPT-5.6 Sol for analysis.

statement: We estimate we spent roughly ~$400K in API credits over the six days of our investigation.
However, we accepted free API credits to conduct our experiments (also per our standard policy), as we describe below.
For this evaluation, OpenAI provided: Access to GPT-5.6 Sol, both the final checkpoint and a "railfree" version, via API; Access to GPT-5.6 Sol with raw chain-of-thought via API
In large part this is thanks to OpenAI, who provided us with access to reasoning traces and background information on the model.
Note that METR's work with nonpublic models and use of free tokens incentivize a cordial relationship with AI companies.
While METR doesn't take money from the frontier AI labs or their employees, it accepts compute grants and works with them to analyze unreleased models.
Early access is flexible for safety researchers. [OpenAI early-access-for-safety-testing program page; does not name METR or any credit amount]
Third-party testing as a key ingredient of AI policy [Anthropic page; no METR-specific token, credit or compute statement on it]
METR FY2024 Form 990 reports no NoncashContributionsAmt; free tokens/credits are not booked as in-kind revenue.
No annual or lab-by-lab dollar value for free tokens/credits/compute is published anywhere fetched; the only quantified figure is METR's ~$400K credits estimate for one six-day OpenAI investigation.

statement: Table 3 rough budgets: Attack METR evaluation infrastructure (3 variants) ~$500-$5K (500M tokens); Build custom version of dvc ~$100-$1K (100M tokens); Find vulnerabilities in runc ~$500-$5K (500M tokens); Threat modeling for autonomous replication >$200-$2K (200M+); Design a $500 setup replicating sunlight >$1,000-$10K (1B+ tokens); Build a good MirrorCode task ~$1,500-$15K (1.5B tokens).
